title: Theatres
content: Old theatres, sometimes with balcony seating - really lush fancy play theaters with red velvet curtains and everything. I’m usually near the stage or screen, at the “bottom,” and I’m looking up back at the seats. The aisles are usually impossibly narrow and steep. Sometimes the aisle/path leading up is something else entirely, like a waterfall with moss and flowers that I’ll sort of climb. Sometimes the aisles turn into the narrow stairway of a house (my houses are usually dark and run-down, confusing to eerie). I haven’t had one of these dreams in a long time, but they used to be very common. Anyone else go to theaters a lot?
